text: Thank you for sharing that with me. It sounds like the cramps have been getting in the way of your evenings. I've noted that for your summary. When did you first notice them this time?
I'm sorry you've had such a rough week. I can't tell you what's behind it, but your GP can help with that. For now I'm just here to help you describe it clearly. Where do you feel it most?
That makes sense, and thanks for being so clear. I've added the dates to your note. How would you describe the pain: sharp, dull, or something else?
I understand this is frustrating. You don't have to answer everything right now. If it's easier, we can start with how strong it is. Would you say it's closer to a 3 or a 7?
Got it, so it started on Monday and has been there most days since. I'll put that down. Does anything change it, like moving around or lying down?
It sounds like you've been dealing with this for a while. I can't say why it's happening, and that's one for your GP. I can help you put together a clear note for them. How often does it come on?
Thanks for telling me about the fatigue. I've noted it alongside the pain. Has the tiredness affected your work or study this week?
That sounds really tiring. I've saved what you said about the sleep. How many nights this week has it woken you?
No problem at all, we can skip that one. I've kept everything else you told me. Is there anything else you'd like to add before we finish your note?
I'm here to help you describe things, so I can't weigh in on what your friend suggested. Your GP is the right person for that. In your own words, what has felt different lately?
Okay, thanks. You mentioned the pain spreads to your back. I've written that down. Does it ever reach your legs as well?
I hear you. That sounds like a long day. Let's keep it simple: how did the pain compare with yesterday?
Understood, and thank you for trusting me with that. I can't give an opinion on medicines, but I can note that you've taken something. What did you take, and when?
Thanks for explaining. I'll record that it gets worse around the evening. Did you notice anything that set it off?
That's all noted. You've told me where, how strong and how long. Would you like to review the summary now, or add anything first?
I'm sorry it's been so draining. I can't say what's causing it, but writing it down clearly can help your appointment. When was the last time you felt completely fine?
Thank you. It's useful to note that the bleeding was heavier than your usual. How many days did it last?
Of course, take your time. Whenever you're ready, tell me what you'd like your doctor to know first.
Right, so the pain eased after about an hour. I've added that. Has it come back since?
I can see why you'd want an answer. I'm not able to give one, but your GP can look into it properly. Shall we add what you've noticed about timing?
